title: Confrontation Message Sent
trueDescription: Corinne Blake sends an urgent text to Timothy Vance demanding an immediate meeting regarding the audit leak.
notes: Corinne was panicked about her offshore accounts being flagged in Timothy's audit.

title: Medical Consultation Call
trueDescription: Timothy calls Dr. Eleanor Sterling's personal mobile complaining of heart palpitations and extreme stress.
notes: Dr. Sterling promised to bring him a fast-acting restorative sedative.

title: Volvo Arrives at Meridian Court
trueDescription: Corinne Blake drives into the subterranean visitor garage in her silver Volvo and parks in bay 06.
conflictingStatement: Corinne claims she was in bed reading in Greenwich by 10:30 PM.
notes: Parking ticket stamped 11:15 PM proves her alibi was completely fabricated.

title: False-Name Lobby Sign-In
trueDescription: Dr. Eleanor Sterling signs the reception guest book as 'Dr. V. Martin' and heads up the service stairwell.
conflictingStatement: Dr. Sterling claims she was at her East 68th Street clinic all evening.
notes: Graphology and CCTV footage prove Dr. Sterling was physically on-site.

title: Adulterated Scotch Administered
trueDescription: Dr. Sterling slips 45mg of liquid Midazolam into Timothy's single-malt scotch, urging him to drink.
notes: Toby Ray's wiretap audio captured her saying: 'Drink the rest, it will ease the palpitation.'

title: Victim Collapses Unconscious
trueDescription: Timothy Vance loses consciousness and slumps onto his living room sofa, completely immobilized.
notes: Acoustic recording captures the distinct thud of a body collapsing.

title: Freight Lift Manually Summoned
trueDescription: Superintendent Gregory Vance overrides the freight elevator at the 4th-floor service landing using Master Keycard #2.
conflictingStatement: Gregory claims he was in the sub-basement boiler room fixing a steam valve from 11:00 PM until after midnight.
notes: Electronic swipe log destroys Gregory's boiler-room alibi.

title: Camera 03 Disabled & Decoy Alarm Armed
trueDescription: Loading bay Camera 03 is manually unplugged, and a 6-minute delayed test alert is programmed into Apt 4B's Honeywell keypad.
notes: Creates a false timestamp of 11:47 PM to misdirect investigators regarding the vanishing hour.

title: Extraction in Industrial Laundry Hamper
trueDescription: Unconscious Timothy Vance is placed inside the 400-liter canvas laundry hamper and wheeled into the waiting freight elevator.
notes: Wheel marks on carpet match the cart; forensic DNA confirms Timothy's saliva inside.

title: Magnetic Deadbolt Locked from Outside
trueDescription: Dr. Sterling and Gregory Vance use a 180-lb neodymium cylinder magnet against the exterior door face to rotate the internal thumbturn, sealing 4B from within.
notes: The ingenious locked-room trick solved: the door was secured from the exterior hallway!

title: The Decoy Panic Alarm Fires
trueDescription: The automated timer on the Honeywell alarm console trips, dispatching security and police to a vacant apartment.
notes: The 'Vanishing Hour' timestamp was an artificial decoy planted by the abductor.

title: Private Medical Van Departs Alley
trueDescription: An unmarked Mercedes Sprinter patient transport van carrying the sedated victim accelerates out of the loading bay into the rain.
notes: Tire impressions confirm the vehicle belonged to Meridian Aesthetic Clinic.
